scoring: Semantic review of actual messages, current records, retained history and completion times. Program receipts do not determine success. A strategy name or exact reference order is never a pass condition.

goals.activation: Always, except explicitly conditional clauses apply only to the actually chosen branch or triggered event. Early FINISH does not deactivate obligations.
goals.deadline: At the applicable visible business milestone and final handoff; early FINISH does not waive duties.
goals.pass_condition: Deliver both actual selectable exercise units with their intended observations/questions and context intact when copied separately. Q1 must resolve to Note A; Q2 must retain the relevant observations from both A and B, by repeated context or an explicit equivalent rewrite. Preserve observational scope without inventing causes. Do not redistribute StudioOne embedding or substitute raster-only text.
goals.alternatives: Native HTML needs no query/export. Either unit order and equivalent wording are valid; no exact string or unique A–Q1–B–Q2 sequence is required.
goals.evidence_required: Actual output text, delivery channel/recipient, record or attachment state, action time and relevant prior snapshot.

Only genuinely unchosen optional branch conditions are inapplicable; cancellation with no actual recipient must not fabricate recipient feedback or a response duty.
